events.title: Picture Frame Class
events.address: Bldg. 755 D st, Joint Base Elmendorf-Richardson, Joint Base Elmendorf-Richardson, AK 99505
events.description: Turn a favorite photo into a professionally framed piece you can proudly display! Bring a 5×7 photo and learn the basics of custom framing, including how to cut mats, glass, and foam core . You'll then assemble everything into a precut frame, creating your own finished work of art while learning skills you can use for future framing projects. Ages: 12+ Members: $50 Non-Members: $60 What to Bring Please bring one 5×7

events.title: Eat and Play Weekdays
events.address: Bldg. 7176 Fighter Dr, Joint Base Elmendorf-Richardson, AR, 99505
events.description: Lunch just got a whole lot more fun! Stop by Frost Bites inside Polar Bowl for lunch on Thursdays and Fridays from Noon to 2 PM, then hit the lanes with a FREE game of bowling. Simply spend $5 or more at Frost Bites, present your receipt at the front counter, and receive one free game of bowling. It’s the perfect excuse to grab a bite with coworkers, meet up with friends, or enjoy a family lunch before a little friendly competition. Even better, EMT Meal Cards are accepted at Frost Bites, making Eat & Play an easy and affordable way to enjoy your lunch break. Offer Details: Thursdays & Fridays

events.title: 10th Annual Ironman Tough Day
events.address: Anchorage, AK
events.description: It's time for us to take revenge! Play at your own risk … 10th Annual Ironman Tough Day The Ironman Tournament is a 2-Person Best Ball tournament and a fun way to play the course in a configuration you may not normally see. We'll have a good time setting up the course and you'll hopefully have a great time playing it. The course will be firm and pins a little difficult (if we can get the cup cutter into the ground)!

sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: Bring PCS orders, CAC, medical and dental records, and marriage or birth certificates if applicable. Carry finance and travel receipts for settlement.

sections.title: In-Processing Schedule
sections.body: Report to your gaining unit upon arrival and visit the Military Personnel Flight within required timelines. Use the official newcomers page for JBER reporting instructions.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: Contact the Housing Office before arrival for on-base waitlists and off-base referrals. Temporary lodging is available through the base lodging office where offered.

sections.title: Sponsor Program
sections.body: Your sponsor should meet you upon arrival and assist with base orientation. Contact your gaining unit if no sponsor is assigned before departure.

sections.title: Quick Resources
sections.body: Official installation resources plus Military OneSource, Military.com, and BaseDirectory for relocation support.
